items.title: McDonald's (MCD) Value Lead Meets A Loyalty Gap In New Zappi Research
items.summary: McDonald's (NYSE:MCD) is the focus of new Zappi research on fast food value perceptions and loyalty in 2026. The study finds McDonald's leads on value deals but trails rivals on emotional loyalty among frequent fast food users. Zappi reports McDonald's is not viewed as a clear leader for family or dinner occasions despite its broad menu and footprint. The Zappi findings on value leadership and weak emotional loyalty only capture part of the McDonald's story for investors. Our analysis turns...

items.title: How Many Shares of McDonald’s, Starbucks or Darden Pay $1,000 a Month in Dividends?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAt today’s prices, $1,000 a month in dividends takes about $424,900 of McDonald’s stock, about $418,100 of Darden Restaurants or about $491,100 of Starbucks. McDonald’s paid out 70% of its free cash flow as dividends over the last 12 months, and analysts expect 69% for fiscal 2026.

items.title: Trump Calls Huang’s Exit “Such a Tragedy” as His Filing Shows Up to $380,000 of Nvidia Buys
items.summary: Key TakeawaysTrump’s September trading report shows up to $380,000 of Nvidia buys, plus Tesla and SpaceX, and sales of $1 million to $5 million each of Home Depot and McDonald’s. The White House says outside firms run the portfolio, and most of the month’s money went into a dividend ETF and municipal bonds.

items.title: 5 Dividend Kings to Buy for Lifelong Income Before the End of November
items.summary: A fat yield means nothing if the cash behind it dries up. Five companies with 50-plus years of dividend raises put safety ahead of income, yet one of them leaves almost no room for error.

items.title: McDonald’s, Publix and Trader Joe’s inducted into ‘Toxic Hall of Shame’ — hit with F grades for chemicals and plastics
items.summary: The companies are among 16 retailers that earned failing grades for chemical safety as more Americans question the ingredients in their food and everyday products.
